_comment: Authored by hand, never captured. SECURITY.md forbids committing call recordings
and private call transcripts, so fixtures are written from what a clinician says
these calls sound like. Keyed by patient id.
Transcripts are invented dialogue for fictional patients, not recordings.

structured_result.evidence_summary: Said last week clashed with a shift and Thursday afternoon works.
